Definition: to be familiar with; by implication, to minister to, be serviceable to, be customary
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be of use or service or profit or benefit; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be of use or service; 1a2) servitor, steward (participle); 1a3) to benefit, profit; 1b) (Hiphil) to be used, be wont, exhibit use or habit, show harmony with, be familiar with, know intimately
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
